description: This file defines data structures and constants related to admission review requests and responses in Kubernetes, including AdmissionReview, AdmissionRequest, AdmissionResponse, and related types and constants.

classes.name: AdmissionReview
classes.description: Represents an admission review request or response.

classes.name: AdmissionRequest
classes.description: Contains details of the admission request, including UID, kind, resource, user info, and objects involved.

classes.name: AdmissionResponse
classes.description: Contains the response to an admission request, including whether it was allowed, patches, and status.

classes.name: PatchType
classes.description: String type representing the patch format, with JSONPatch as a constant.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: String type representing the operation type, with constants CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, CONNECT.
